packageRules.description: One weekly PR for routine updates. Majors stay separate: they are the ones that break.
Patch and digest updates merge themselves once CI passes; minor and major wait for a human.

Upstream mcp-ynab is the whole tool surface and it can edit the budget, so its releases get their own PR and always wait for a human, patch included. CI's tool test checks every upstream tool is still served.
Pin Dockerfile images by digest, so a rebuild cannot silently pull different layers.
Only patch releases and digest updates of Python 3.13. A Python version bump is a deliberate change, not a weekly update.
